map.ISO 公差表偏差常以 μm 给出，本工具内部转 mm（÷1000）。注意 ES: ISO tolerance tables give deviations in μm, and this tool converts them to mm internally (/1000). Make sure the units of ES/EI/es/ei are consistent before calculating.

map.纯间隙配合不能靠摩擦传扭矩，需键/销/过盈辅助；间隙仅保证相对运动与润滑。: A pure clearance fit cannot transmit torque by friction and needs a key, pin or interference fit; the clearance only guarantees relative movement and lubrication.
